name: subscriptions-open-for-change-plan
evidence: pkg_plans.sp_change_plan cursor c_open_subs (02_pkg_plans.sql:75-80, ap-781940a6e5): open subscriptions (ends_on IS NULL), without the FOR UPDATE lock
source_sql: SELECT id AS "subscriptionId", tenant_id AS "tenantId", plan_id AS "planId", status_cd AS "statusCd", starts_on AS "startsOn" FROM subscriptions WHERE ends_on IS NULL

name: subscriptions-covering-feb-2026
evidence: pkg_rating.compute_rating / sp_finalize_rating covering-subscription lookup (03_pkg_rating.sql:55-63 ap-22fec4f2aa, :172-178 ap-b6d8685d76) for the exercised period 2026-02-01..2026-02-28, folded to one row per tenant
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS "tenantId", COUNT(*) AS "coveringSubs", MAX(starts_on) AS "latestStartsOn" FROM subscriptions WHERE starts_on <= DATE '2026-02-28' AND (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= DATE '2026-02-01') GROUP BY tenant_id

name: subscriptions-hist-revisions
evidence: trg_subscriptions_hist (01_tables.sql:206-222, ap-bdfdef0db0): :OLD rows written by the confirmed UPDATEs of pkg_plans.sp_change_plan (ap-a7af1a6156) and pkg_dunning.sp_suspend_overdue (ap-d3754b6b8a); revisions per subscription and operation
source_sql: SELECT id AS "subscriptionId", hist_op AS "histOp", COUNT(*) AS "revisions" FROM subscriptions_hist GROUP BY id, hist_op
